flats.title: Vacation rental booking calendar app | Rental Planner
flats.desc: Booking calendar for short and long stays: check-ins, deposits, cleaning, payments and Airbnb, Booking.com and Agoda sync via iCal. Free for up to 2 units.
flats.h1: Booking calendar for apartments and vacation homes
flats.lead: See every apartment and every booking on one screen. Check-ins, deposits, payments and cleaning between guests, without spreadsheets.

features.d: Every apartment, house or room on one screen. Free dates and occupancy are visible at a glance.
The app finds bookings that overlap by dates before two guests show up at the same door.
On the Business plan, bookings from booking sites arrive via iCal, and your calendar goes back to block the busy dates.
Prepayments, balances and deposits inside every booking. Revenue and expenses by unit for any period.
Check-in, check-out and unpaid balance reminders. Message templates fill in the guest's name, dates and amount.
Invite a manager or a unit owner and choose what each of them sees: bookings, finances, expenses or clients.

faq.q: Does it work for both short and long stays?
faq.a: Yes. A booking can last one night or several months: the calendar, payments and reminders work the same way.

faq.q: How do I connect Airbnb and Booking.com?
faq.a: On the Business plan, open a unit, tap “Calendar sync” and paste the iCal link from the booking site. Bookings appear in your calendar within 20-30 minutes, then everything updates automatically.

faq.q: How many apartments can I add for free?
faq.a: Up to 2 units with bookings for the last month, with no time limit. The Basic plan covers up to 12 units, Premium and Business have no limit.

faq.q: Can a manager use the app too?
faq.a: Yes. On the Business plan, add team members by email and give each of them their own units and permissions: for example, bookings without finances.

cars.title: Car rental software with a fleet booking calendar | Rental Planner
cars.desc: Booking calendar for car rental: pick-up and return, deposits, mileage and payments for every car. See which cars are free on any date. Free for up to 2 cars.
cars.h1: Car rental management in one calendar
cars.lead: Every car in your fleet on one screen: who has it, when it comes back, how much is paid and how much is still owed.

features.d: Each car is a separate unit. See which cars are free on any date without calling around.
Pick-up and return times, the deposit and mileage from meter readings right in the booking.
The app warns you when two bookings for the same car overlap by dates.
Prepayments and balances for every rental, plus expenses for washing, maintenance and advertising.
Clients and your own form fields, for example a driver's license number. Everything is saved for the next rental.
Reminders about pick-ups, returns and unpaid balances, so nothing slips through.

faq.q: Does it suit a small fleet?
faq.a: Yes. It is free for up to 2 cars, the Basic plan covers up to 12 units, and Premium and Business have no limit.

faq.q: Can I track deposits and mileage?
faq.a: Yes. Choose car rental on first launch and the field names adapt: pick-up, return, deposit and mileage are in every booking.

faq.q: Can several managers work with one fleet?
faq.a: Yes, on the Business plan. Create a company, add managers by email and give each of them their own cars and permissions.

faq.q: Can I use it on a computer?
faq.a: Yes. There is a web version: sign in with a QR code from the app, no password needed. Your data and subscription are shared across devices.

boats.title: Boat and yacht rental booking software | Rental Planner
boats.desc: Booking calendar for boat and yacht rentals: departure and return times, prepayments, group size and the captain's contacts. Phone, tablet and web.
boats.h1: Booking calendar for boat and yacht rentals
boats.lead: Departures, returns and prepayments for every boat on one screen. The booking card keeps the group size and the captain's contacts.
boats.features_title: Made for charters and boat rentals

features.d: Boats, yachts, SUP boards or jet skis as separate units. Free slots are visible at once.
Departure and return times in every booking, so the dock knows who is going out and when.
Group size, the captain's contacts and your own fields right in the booking card.
Prepayment, balance and deposit for every trip. Revenue by boat for any period.
On the Premium plan, send the client a neat invoice with your terms and a QR code for payment.
No signal at the pier? Keep working in the app, everything syncs once you are back online.

faq.q: Can I rent out SUP boards and jet skis too?
faq.a: Yes. A unit can be anything: a yacht, a boat, a SUP board or a jet ski. Add each one and track its bookings in the calendar.

faq.q: Can I send the client an invoice?
faq.a: Yes, on the Premium plan: a PDF invoice and receipt with your terms and a QR code for payment. Send it to the client or print it.

faq.q: Does it work without internet?
faq.a: Yes. The calendar and bookings work offline, and everything syncs once you are back online.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Up to 2 units with bookings for the last month are free with no time limit. Paid plans add more units, reminders, statistics and receipts.

pets.title: Pet hotel and boarding kennel booking software | Rental Planner
pets.desc: Booking calendar for pet hotels and boarding kennels: kennels and rooms as units, pet names, owner contacts and check-in reminders. Free for up to 2 units.
pets.lead: Kennels and rooms in one calendar, the pet's name and the owner's contacts in every booking, and reminders about check-ins and check-outs.

features.d: Each kennel, enclosure or room is a separate unit. Free places on any date are visible at a glance.
The pet's name, the owner's contacts and your own fields: breed, diet or vaccinations.
The app reminds you about check-ins, check-outs and unpaid stays on time.
Two pets will not end up booked into the same kennel: the app finds overlapping bookings.
Prepayments and balances for every stay, expenses for food and supplies, revenue for any period.
On the Business plan, give staff access to bookings and keep the finances to yourself.

faq.q: Can I record breed, diet and vaccinations?
faq.a: Yes. Add your own form fields and fill them in for every pet. The data is saved in the client card for the next visit.

faq.q: Can my staff use the app?
faq.a: Yes, on the Business plan. Add staff by email and choose what each of them sees: for example, bookings without finances.

faq.q: Can I send the owner a receipt?
faq.a: Yes, on the Premium plan: a PDF invoice and receipt with your terms and a QR code for payment.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Up to 2 units with bookings for the last month are free with no time limit. Add more kennels on a paid plan.

tools.title: Tool and equipment rental tracking software | Rental Planner
tools.desc: Track tool and equipment rentals: every drill and generator as a unit, who took it, when it comes back and how much is owed. Free for up to 2 units.
tools.lead: Every hammer drill, generator and scaffold as a separate unit: who took it, when it comes back and how much is still owed.

features.d: Drills, generators, mixers or scaffolding: each item has its own row in the calendar.
Each rental has a pick-up and return date. The app reminds you about equipment returns.
Deposit, prepayment and balance in every booking. See who still owes money at once.
Clients and your own form fields: phone, passport details or notes. Repeat rentals take seconds.
The app finds bookings that overlap by dates, so one generator is not promised to two clients.
On the Premium plan, full statistics and Excel export for your accounting.

faq.q: Is there a limit on the number of items?
faq.a: Free covers 2 units, Basic up to 12, and Premium and Business have no limit.

faq.q: Does the app remind me about returns?
faq.a: Yes, on the Premium plan: reminders about returns and unpaid balances arrive on time.

faq.q: Can I work from a computer?
faq.a: Yes. Open the web version and sign in with a QR code from the app. Data is shared across all devices.

faq.q: Can I export rentals to Excel?
faq.a: Yes, on the Premium plan, together with full statistics.

bikes.title: Motorcycle, scooter and bike rental software | Rental Planner
bikes.desc: Booking calendar for motorcycle, scooter and bicycle rentals: every vehicle as a unit, deposits, payments and message templates. Free for up to 2 units.
bikes.h1: Booking calendar for motorbike and bicycle rentals
bikes.lead: Seasonal rentals without spreadsheets: a calendar for every vehicle, deposits and payments in each booking, and ready-made messages for customers.

features.d: Motorbikes, scooters and bicycles as separate units. Free vehicles on any date at a glance.
Deposit, prepayment and balance in every booking, without a separate notebook.
The customer's name, dates and amount are filled in automatically. Send via Telegram or WhatsApp in one tap.
Pick-up, return and unpaid balance reminders, so no bike goes missing from the schedule.
See which bike earns the most and where the money goes: revenue and expenses by unit for any period.
On the Business plan, managers see bookings, and you decide who sees the finances.

faq.q: Does it suit a small seasonal rental?
faq.a: Yes. Start with 2 units for free, the Basic plan covers up to 12, and Premium and Business have no limit.

faq.q: Can I see which bike earns the most?
faq.a: Yes. Statistics show revenue and expenses for every unit for any period.

faq.q: How do I send rental details to a customer?
faq.a: Use message templates on the Premium plan: the name, dates and amount are filled in, send it via Telegram or WhatsApp in one tap.

faq.q: Does it work on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, there is tablet support and a web version. One account works on all your devices.
